ParagonSpear.description: All of <style="Faction_Custodes">Tyrith's</style> hits that are <style="Stat_CritDamage">Crits</style> deal the maximum possible <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style>. At the beginning of Tyrith's turn, she attacks a random enemy within range {[range]} and deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Bolter">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bolter Damage</style> to it. If there is an enemy adjacent to her, this range is reduced to 1.
